A fully dynamic key that no check can follow.

The check is off by default.

A fully dynamic key, such as `t(key)`, has no static prefix. No check can follow it. Turn this check on to find such usages.

## Configure

Turn the check on in `checks`:

```ts [x18n.config.ts]
import { defineConfig } from 'x18n'

export default defineConfig({
  checks: {
    'dynamic-key': 'warning',
  },
})
```

`x18n check --only dynamic-key` runs this check alone. `x18n check --skip dynamic-key` skips it for one run.
